# meok-omnibus-tracker-mcp
# **The live source of truth for the EU AI Act Digital Omnibus delay.**

## Install
```bash
pip install meok-omnibus-tracker-mcp
```

## Auth & Rate Limits
- Free tier: 10 calls/day. No API key required.
- Pro tier (£79/mo): unlimited + signed attestations.
- Enterprise (£1,499/mo): white-label.

## Tools

### `query_article`
Query Omnibus delay status for specific article (e.g., 'Article 11').

### `get_trilogue_status`
Get current trilogue negotiation status.

### `generate_compliance_update`
Generate compliance update memo for leadership, covering Omnibus impact,


## Maintainer
MEOK AI Labs · hello@meok.ai · https://meok.ai · MIT licensed

## Pairs with
Governance moat: pair this tool with any of MEOK's 38 governance MCPs (EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2, CRA, GDPR, ISO 42001, etc.) for full compliance coverage.
